farms.name: Grandad Farms
farms.summary: Regenerative family farm raising Freedom Ranger broilers moved to fresh pasture 7 days a week, plus laying hens raised with Saint John's Organic Farm in Emmett. No medications, vaccines, hormones, or antibiotics; non-GMO, corn-free, soy-free feed. Chickens processed at a local USDA-inspected facility.
products: Whole pasture chicken, listed at $7/lb (10% off 40 lb+)
Pasture eggs, unwashed and ungraded, 1 dozen every 2 weeks for $9 (subscription; the farm's site labels them organic, no certification listed)
Non-GMO, corn-free, soy-free poultry and pig feed, oyster shells, alfalfa pellets
farms.access: Pickup in Emmett or in Meridian at The Karlfeldt Center. Friday delivery in the Treasure Valley for $20, free over $250. No shipping listed.
farms.note: Chicken and eggs showed out of stock when checked.
